about: Questions a person asks after three years of history (history.json), with calendars (catalystcal) and household work (Longhouse). Today is Monday 9 November 2026 in America/Denver. Each question needs a look up, and many need two (a fact and a date, a project and its tasks). Do not change this file after a run; make a new version.
